info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Alkaline Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of detailed information for alkaline recliners in the product catalog. It allows users to specify various attributes and characteristics of the recliners, ensuring comprehensive data management. E-commerce platforms and inventory management systems can leverage this API to enhance their product offerings with accurate and rich descriptions. This operation is crucial for businesses looking to optimize their catalog, improve customer experience, and streamline product updates.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed specifications for alkaline recliners. Users can submit relevant information to enhance the product database and improve customer experience.
